name: California Historical Society, 678 Mission
note: Museum audit 2026-10-04 (Commons '2017 California Historical Society 678 Mission Street.jpg'): two storeys painted red, grey-white ornate pilasters, a deep bracketed cornice, arched shopfronts; was the bake's sfapartment.

name: Angel Island Immigration Station, Detention Barracks
note: Commons 'Angel Island detention barracks.JPG' (2026-10-05): two long storeys, white over a tan lower storey on a grey base, a dark grey hipped roof; was brick.

name: Railroad & Ferry Depot Museum, Tiburon
note: Museum census 2026-10-05 (Commons 'Tiburon Railroad & Ferry Depot Museum in 2017.jpg'): the 1884 depot, two storeys of pale grey board-and-batten, brown-grey window frames and belt course, a pale green corrugated gable roof. Was a 12 m sfapartment block. tiburon-depot.ts.
